LESSON: THE KENYA NATIONAL ANTHEM

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Appreciation
Topic 3.1: The Kenya National Anthem
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Kenya National Anthem, part of Appreciation in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How is the Kenya National Anthem performed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Kenya National Anthem together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner keenly listens to, and talks about the words of the Kenya National Anthem.

• Citizenship: The learner takes pride in performing the Kenya National Anthem.

Values:
• Respect: The learner performs the first stanza of the Kenya national anthem observing the anthem etiquette.

• Unity: The learner in groups, take turns to perform the first stanza of Kenya National Anthem.

• Patriotism: The learner performs the first stanza of the Kenya National Anthem observing anthem etiquette.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: The learner applies knowledge acquired in observing anthem etiquette in daily life.

Link to other subjects:
